subject: CPU DVFS on MT6893: the CSRAM is uninitialised SRAM (not a wrong base). P10 images + 0106; the real fix is the stock kernel's cpuhvfs/SSPM bring-up
body: Evidence (3 boots, c6m/c6o): the 0x11bc00 region matches the DT (dvfsp@0011bc00 size 0x1400) but its 1280 words are SRAM power-up noise: 49.7% ones, 1280 distinct words, no zero/0xffffffff word, byte entropy 7.95, and the SAME words every boot with only ~3/32 bits different (pairwise mean Hamming 2.9/3.0/3.3 vs 16 for random). Nothing has ever written it -> no DVFS firmware/engine runs; discovery 0x0 is correct and no base would change it. Canonical cpufreq-hw bases for 1+3+4 are 0x10/0x130/0x250 (public bindings 0x11bc10 +0x120) and are inside the scan. On the reference SoCs the bootloader starts MCUPM; on MT6893 the Android kernel does the init (stock-Image 4.19 strings: FAILED TO PRE-INIT CPUHVFS, [DVFS][CPU_%s][OPP%d] volt/freq tables from EEM/efuse, sspm_ipi, buck vproc1/vproc2, vsram_proc1; public sspm-cpufreq.c: IPI_DVFS_INIT to SSPM then writel(opp_index, csram+0x37c+cluster*4)). So: ansuz-port, your 0099 n2csram offsets (0x354/0x3a4) read the same noise; and a PERF_STATE-style port needs the SSPM IPI + OPP table bring-up reverse engineered from stock-Image first (disassembly of the cpuhvfs init), plus a read-only SSPM mailbox look; I did NOT attempt blind PLL/Vproc writes. 0106 (patch a1090004): csram self-diagnosis line, canonical-domain probe lines, utilisation governor + UI floor as tested pure logic (NOT wired: it needs per-CPU busy time and a UI kick that 0099 does not export; ansuz-port: can level b export busy ns per cpu and a kick?), goto_row, and placement that switches 0099 mode 0xf on by itself only when the big cores measure >=1.3x the little ones (so no n2sch arg: n2fbhz=60 n2cpu=2000 = 606 chars). Images: ui654fb60cpu2 782916e8 (kernel A'' 9b98ad80) and ui654fb60cpuab 45467c05 (kernel B'' 875a3c99, scheduler hooks in so NORD2 SCHED lines mean something), both 606 chars. Both will show the same CPUCLK as P9 (big cores ~730); the cpuab image additionally answers where backboardd runs. run_all.sh green (7 FINAL, 6 XNU, 2 MODEL, 32/32 identical). Decision for Root: authorise the stock-Image disassembly of the CPU DVFS init (host-only) as the next step; I recommend against any further device boot for CPU clocks until that is understood.
